summary: The frozen terminal orphan double-release candidate does not require a harness update. The old destructor does not release last_comment; the changed parser clears that pointer after releasing it, before the new destructor can inspect it. Full target coverage remains unverified.
missing_information: The complete ucl_parser_add_string_priority call path and comment ownership helpers are needed to certify full target coverage.

claims.necessity_reason: For the frozen condition, neither version releases the terminal orphan again through parser->last_comment during the harness's parse and destruction sequence.

before.requirement: If terminal parsing has released an orphan comment, parser destruction must not release it again.
before.reason: The terminal path releases the comment. The complete old destructor has no last_comment release.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete old destructor never releases parser->last_comment.

after.requirement: If terminal parsing has released an orphan comment, parser destruction must not release it again.
after.reason: The changed terminal path clears last_comment immediately after release, so the new destructor's conditional release does not repeat it.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The new destructor releases last_comment only if its pointer is set.

claims.comparison_reason: The same old harness parses once and frees the parser on its no-error path. The frozen double-release consequence is prevented on both source versions.
